thread:
maria: Urgent help needed. SBMarket customer can't pull marketplace image over their privatelink path. Getting 403 with an X-Privatelink-Endpoint that doesn't match their account. Go-live is tomorrow morning.

alex: Can you paste the curl and the registry URL? We should try to repro from a test VPC using privatelink.

maria: URL: https://marketplace.redwood.internal/registry/sbmarket/enterprise:2026-03-20. Their curl: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://marketplace.redwood.internal/registry/sbmarket/enterprise:2026-03-20"
* Connected to marketplace.redwood.internal (10.10.0.5) port 443 (#0)
> GET /registry/sbmarket/enterprise:2026-03-20 HTTP/1.1
> Host: marketplace.redwood.internal
> Authorization: Bearer <token>
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< Content-Type: application/json
< X-Privatelink-Endpoint: arn:aws:privatelink:us-west-2:123456789012:endpoint/incorrect-vpc
{
  "error": "privatelink_endpoint_mismatch",
  "message": "endpoint configured for account does not match request source"
}
```

samir: That X-Privatelink-Endpoint ARN is not one we expect. Two likely causes: their egress SNATs traffic to a different VPC/TGW, or our edge routing is returning the wrong endpoint. I'll pull subscription records and routing entries.

jamie: Also possible a partner VPC is advertising routes into our edge. Ops should check BGP adjacencies.

alex: Short-term workaround: we can generate a one-off signed pull URL for the image so their installer can continue. Avoids touching their privatelink config right before go-live. Any legal/billing concerns?

maria: Sales owns the contract; I can ping them, but they might be slow. Customer needs a yes/no.

samir: I can create a pre-signed artifact link (24h) but will record on the contract ticket for billing to reconcile metering. Also creating a delivery-workaround tag for audit.

samir: Quick data: subscription record shows privileged_endpoint_arn=arn:aws:privatelink:us-west-2:123456789012:endpoint/cust-sbmarket-9876. Marketplace routing points cust-sbmarket-9876 -> 10.10.0.5 and shared-marketplace-1111 -> 10.10.0.6. The incorrect-vpc ARN the customer saw isn't present in our DB.

alex: That points to their side SNAT/TGW or an external partner route. Ops: can you validate our edge logs for this request and confirm which endpoint mapping served it?

jamie: Long-term engineering fixes to consider: (1) allow accounts to register extra permitted endpoint ARNs (config change), (2) change auth to validate based on signed headers from the privatelink proxy (requires infra change), or (3) add an IP/range-based fallback mapping (brittle). Option (1) seems the least invasive and audit-friendly.

samir: Action items now: 1) I created a 24h pre-signed pull URL and DM'd the customer; added note to ticket INC-4521 and flagged billing for reconciliation. 2) Ops-oncall paged to investigate BGP/routing and verify edge mappings (pagerduty: network-oncall). 3) Schedule architecture review with customer + our network SME first thing tomorrow to determine permanent fix.

maria: Customer confirmed the presigned URL worked and install resumed. Go-live still scheduled for tomorrow morning. I'm scheduling the arch review at 09:00 PST and will invite their network lead.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4521 - marketplace-privatelink-auth-mismatch. Pager duty: network-oncall.

alex: Samir, please add an internal postmortem placeholder and label this as delivery-impacting so we can prioritize a config change if this repeats.

samir: Done. Created PM placeholder and added tag delivery-workaround + needs-config.

jamie: I'll run the customer architecture review and capture requirements for supporting transit/NAT setups. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
